description: This source file defines the 'ExecCommandResolution' struct in Swift, which provides methods for resolving command paths, parsing shell command strings, and handling allowlists and environment variables for command execution. It appears to be part of a larger system for security or command execution management.

classes.name: ExecCommandResolution
classes.description: A struct encapsulating the resolution of executable commands, including path resolution, command parsing, and allowlist pattern generation.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main entry point for resolving a command string into an executable path resolution, considering raw input and environment.

methods.name: resolveForAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves a command into a list of resolutions suitable for allowlist validation, handling shell wrappers and complex command chains.

methods.name: resolveAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Collects allowlist patterns for the command, up to a specified depth, to support security filtering.

methods.name: resolveExecutable
methods.description: Resolves a raw executable string into a full path and associated metadata.

methods.name: resolveShellSegmentExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the executable in a shell command segment.

methods.name: collectAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Recursively collects patterns for allowlist based on command structure, environment, and shell wrappers.

methods.name: unwrapShellMultiplexerInvocation
methods.description: Unwraps shell multiplexers like busybox or toybox to get the actual invocation command.

methods.name: parseFirstToken
methods.description: Parses the first token from a command string, handling quotes.

methods.name: tokenizeShellWords
methods.description: Tokenizes a shell command string into individual words respecting quotes and escapes.

methods.name: splitShellCommandChain
methods.description: Splits a shell command string into separate command segments based on delimiters, respecting quote contexts.
